specs_note: height_cm, weight_kg, degrees_of_freedom, walk_speed_ms and runtime_minutes confirmed by the product owner against Fourier's own official GR-2 documentation (2026-08-19); height_cm and weight_kg were already on file and independently match that documentation. walk_speed_ms converted from the source's stated 5 km/h (5 / 3.6 = 1.39 m/s); this schema has no km/h field. payload_kg (10 kg) is unchanged and remains separately sourced -- Fourier's documentation separately states an approximately 3 kg SINGLE-HAND load capacity, a distinct measurement this schema has no field for, recorded here rather than conflated with payload_kg or dropped.
